transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I feel like I just cannot get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. It's getting really frustrating. Um, my supplies, my due dates, receipts, and assignment notes... they all just end up in these big piles everywhere. And when I try to deal with it, I honestly just don't know what to do first.
Do you feel anxious or worried when you’re not able to keep things organized, or when things are out of place?

Um, I wouldn't really say I feel anxious or worried, no. It's not like I panic just because things are messy or out of place. It's more just... annoying, I guess? Like, the mess itself doesn't really bother me until I actually need to find a specific receipt for my shop or, you know, turn in an assignment. That's when I get frustrated because I can't find what I need, but I don't really get anxious about the disorganization itself.
Do you often find yourself putting off starting tasks, even when you know they’re important or need to be done soon?

Um, no, not really. I don't think I have a problem starting things. If I know an assignment is due or I need to make something for my shop, I usually just jump right in. It's not that I put it off... it's more just, you know, keeping all the pieces and notes organized once I actually do start. But starting the task itself? No, I haven't really noticed myself delaying that.

Do you find it hard to stay organized or pay attention in other areas of your life, like at home, in social situations, or when running errands—things like forgetting appointments, losing items often, or struggling to follow through on chores or plans?

Um, no, not really. It's honestly just my schoolwork and the shop that give me trouble. I don't really lose my personal things, like my keys or my phone, and I'm pretty good about remembering plans with my friends or going to appointments. Chores around the house are fine, too. It's really just... yeah, just keeping track of all the papers and supplies for my classes and my business. Outside of that, I feel like I'm doing okay.
Do you find it hard to stay focused or tend to get distracted easily while working on tasks, even when you're trying to pay attention?

Yeah, I do. Like, if I'm in class or even just watching a video for one of my business assignments, I'll start out listening just fine. But then, after maybe a few minutes, my mind just... wanders. I'll start thinking about new charm designs for my shop, or ideas for orders, and then suddenly I realize I've completely missed half of what was just said. It's pretty frustrating.
Do you often find yourself making careless mistakes or having trouble finishing tasks once you've started them?

Yeah, I do. Like, if a teacher or someone from a vendor meeting gives me a few steps to do, I usually handle the first part fine. But then later I'll find out I completely skipped something important... like forgetting to attach a form, or not finishing the last part of an order note. I just don't always make it all the way through the instructions before I think I'm done.
Do you often feel restless, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively without thinking things through?

Yeah, I definitely have a hard time sitting still. Like, when I have to sit through lectures or study group meetings, my leg is always bouncing. Or I'll be clicking a pen, or just messing with beads or key rings in my bag. Honestly, I usually don't even realize I'm doing it until someone points it out or I catch myself. I just can't seem to just sit there without moving something.
